title: NAV IR 1 FAULT

actions.say: Attitude and heading switching, captain side, select to the number 3 inertial reference.
actions.ack: Captain attitude and heading on inertial reference 3.

actions.say: Cross-check attitude, heading, and navigation against the standby instruments and the opposite side.
Expect a possible loss of one autopilot and flight director; select the remaining side.

status: Status. Inertial reference 1 lost; the captain is displaying inertial reference 3.
Autopilot 1 may be unavailable; use autopilot 2.
Navigation accuracy is preserved on the remaining inertial references; monitor for any drift.
